video_title: Why The Celtics Are BETTER This Year!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Celtics' reliance on Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: I think they're a little too reliant on Jayson Tatum to be among the elite teams.
quotes.quote: I don't think they'll win as many games as they did last year because the East is better. They're going to be good, but I think they're a little too reliant on Jayson Tatum to be among the elite teams. Paul George is off to a great start, but there are going to be doubts on how much he holds up. I don't know who's next. I like Payton Pritchard, but I don't know if there's enough there for them to really contend. Joe Mazzulla does a great job, you know they're going to defend, you know they're going to play hard, they're going to win a lot of games, but I don't see them at the end of the year being there with New York or a healthy Philly.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the Celtics' need for an X-factor
quotes.excerpt: They almost need one of these players to have a coming out party and be that X-factor.
quotes.quote: It reminds me of the Lakers of the East. You know what you're going to get with Jayson Tatum. Paul George has been surprisingly good and healthy, but how can Hugo Gonzalez take the next step? What can you get from Shai Gilgeous-Alexander? What can you get from guys like John Wall? They almost need one of these players to have a coming out party and be that X-factor for this team where you know what you're going to get from the main core. Outside those top three or four guys, they're a little thin with depth and you don't know where that production is going to come from. Joe Mazzulla is a great coach, they're going to play the right way, they play unselfish, but they live and die by the outside shot.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the Celtics' defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: I might be more of a Joe Mazzulla fan than anybody else that they have in uniform.
quotes.quote: I'm done doubting the Celtics. I might be more of a Joe Mazzulla fan than anybody else that they have in uniform because he's proven I'm going to figure this thing out. They've always worn their heads on being a great defensive team. Last year we had the conversation with Jayson Tatum going out, we don't know what they were going to look like. Jaylen Brown was able to lead them to a great successful season, they fell short. This year Jaylen Brown is traded, we don't know what Jayson Tatum is going to do. They're five and two and they're off to another great start.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Brad Stevens' talent evaluation
quotes.excerpt: Brad Stevens has just shown to be a great judge of talent.
quotes.quote: Brad Stevens has just shown to be a great judge of talent. They're signing guys like Baylor Scheierman and Luka Garza. Between their scouting and their selections of players and then their player development, if you would have told me after his first year that Payton Pritchard was going to be a sixth man of the year, I would have said absolutely not. Sam Hauser, they've just done a great job. Everybody they brought in contributes. One of those guys is from the Jordan Walsh, Hugo Gonzalez, Baylor Scheierman group, somebody from that group has got to take an even bigger jump.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the Rockets' complete roster
quotes.excerpt: This is the most complete Rockets team I've seen in a while.
quotes.quote: I believe they do. The fact that they won last night with Kevin Durant scoring 12 points, I can't remember the last time I've seen that. It goes to show the talent that's on this roster, it goes to show how locked in this team is and how complete of a team this is. I think they have it at every position. I think they have the depth, I think they have the starting five, I think they have the guard play and they have the superstars to get them over the hump. So this is the most complete Rockets team I've seen in a while, and I think they're the real deal.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Rockets' elite two-way play
quotes.excerpt: They're a top five, six team offensively, they're a top five, six team defensively.
quotes.quote: They're pretty elite on both sides, right? They're a top five, six team offensively, they're a top five, six team defensively. They have it all, they can beat you inside, they can beat you outside. Alperen Sengun looks like he's healthy and doing his thing. Kevin Durant obviously is going to be the guy with the ball in his hands at the end of the game. Last year we kept harping on they were just missing that setup guy. Well now they got Fred VanVleet. Another year of Reed Sheppard getting comfortable and getting his feet wet. They have depth. I love the signing of Marcus Smart, another tough guy, a three and D type of guy. And we know Ime Udoka, he's a great coach.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Rockets' potential for growth
quotes.excerpt: They're going to get Steven Adams back at some point in there.
quotes.quote: They're not whole yet either. This is a team that was the best offensive rebounding team in the league last year. They're going to get Steven Adams back at some point in there, who Blake Griffin was touting early in the year last year, deservedly so, could be a sixth man of the year candidate. We always think of guys like Alperen Sengun just scorers and stuff, but you know what he was doing. They didn't have Reed Sheppard last night, and I think last year, having to play without Fred and a Min Thompson and Reed Sheppard having to handle the ball and make decisions and everything else, they went through the growing pains of that. That's only going to help them as players as they come along.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Rockets' need for shooting
quotes.excerpt: The one thing I do question when we hit playoff time, do they have enough shooting?
quotes.quote: The one thing I do question when we hit playoff time, do they have enough shooting? I don't know if your offense can be built around throw it up at the rim and go get it, which is pretty much what their offense becomes a lot of times. And Alperen Sengun is off to the same start he was off to last year, making some threes, shooting the ball, that all went south. We'll see how it goes this year. I don't know if they have enough shooting come playoff time, but that's really my only concern besides health, which is a concern for everybody in the league.
